correctness.rationale: Partitioned the cycle by successive permanent-site gaps. For a length-ell gap, the reached run lengths yield P(Xell=j)=(j+1)q^2 p^j for j<=ell-2, P(Xell=ell-1)=ell q p^(ell-1), and P(Xell=ell)=p^ell. Independent gap PGFs multiply. Reconstructed the exact balancing identity (Q_a Q_b-Q_(a-1)Q_(b+1))/(1-z)=E with nonnegative coefficient signs, equality only (2,0); this proves full stochastic order under majorization rather than mere means. J connectivity is at most one failed gap; summing disjoint cases gives p^S(sum p^(-L_i)-k+1), strictly Schur-convex under balancing. Full binomial coupling equality requires no interior inaccessible survivor, equivalent max gap<=2 and feasibility n<=3k. Independent exact-rational direct BFS checked 153 finite cycle layouts; 270 balancing comparisons.
residual_risks: Only static finite C_n, i.i.d identical Bernoulli survival, permanently functional protected sites; no dynamic metapopulation persistence.
The (2,0)->(1,1) move is tail-law equal despite strictly changing J.
Finite enumeration corroborates polynomial identity, not universal stochastic order.

value.rationale: Two naturally competing conservation surrogates are mathematically distinct: total functioning habitat reachable from at least one permanently protected refuge and continuous functioning connectivity among all refuges. The theorem obtains opposite global placement orders at every tail threshold, a sharp non-strict equality case and the exact n<=3k ceiling threshold. Such distributional statements go beyond expectation-only/ecological intuition.
residual_risks: Interpret only as consequences of idealized static percolation; not biological viability or field recommendation.

final_claim: For iid Bernoulli site-failure on a cycle with k permanent refuges, gap balancing increases every reachable-survivor upper tail but strictly decreases the probability that all refuges remain connected; complete binomial reachability is feasible iff n<=3k.
limitations: Independent identical site failures and permanently functional refuges only.
No statement about ecological persistence, temporal dispersal or empirical optimization.
Blowes–Connolly full paper not accessible (Oxford VPN disconnected), and a generic percolation majorization antecedent may exist.
